The editorial standard

Useful enough to answer a real parent question.

First-hand

Begin with a real CAIS practice, educator observation, activity or family question—not a generic topic.

Specific

Explain what children do, what educators notice and how the experience connects to learning.

Verifiable

Use current school facts and credible external sources; distinguish evidence from CAIS philosophy.

Owned

Publish on the school domain with a review owner, date and clear contact path so the school becomes the canonical source.

A question about your child?

Articles can inform. A conversation makes it personal.

Speak with Admissions about your child’s age, current stage and what you want from their school experience.
